column1: # The index examples/typst-xref-places.qmd prints in a Typst render (M119).
# Derived BY HAND from that source, under the ORACLE RULE at the head of
# tests/run-tests.sh, and never copied from a render. The row shape is the one
# Each cross-reference mark names Oak, which the body marks on page 2, so
# every target prints. A cross-reference mark adds no locator (M118), and
# each of these terms has no other mark, so its row has no locator:
#   ash    a heading the table of contents lists, page 2
#   beech  the caption of a picture with an id, page 3
#   cork   the caption of a table with an id, page 4, `see-also=`
#   date   the caption of a picture with no id, page 5
#   elm    the alt text of an image that is not a figure, page 6
#   jade   a callout's first heading, page 9
#   gum    the same alt text as elm, page 6
#   lark   the alt text of an image in the caption of a picture with an id,
